classDiagram
    class QaJob {
        id
        number
        name
        description
        command
        workingDirectory
        shell
        timeoutSeconds
        enabled
        createdBy
        updatedAt
    }
    class QaJobDesignLink {
        qaJobId
        targetType
        designExternalId
        sortOrder
    }
    class QaJobTaskLink {
        qaJobId
        taskId
        sortOrder
    }
    class QaJobTag {
        qaJobId
        tag
    }
    class QaRun {
        id
        triggerSource
        querySnapshot
        status
        startedAt
        finishedAt
        summary
    }
    class QaJobRun {
        id
        qaRunId
        qaJobId
        commandSnapshot
        status
        exitCode
        startedAt
        finishedAt
        durationMs
        output
    }
    QaJob "1" --> "0..*" QaJobDesignLink : design specs
    QaJob "1" --> "0..*" QaJobTaskLink : tasks
    QaJob "1" --> "0..*" QaJobTag : tags

    QaJob "1" --> "0..*" QaJobRun : evidence
